subject: general
question: Which among the following keyboard shortcuts is used to insert a hyperlink for the selected text in Microsoft Word?
solution:
**The correct option is 1) Ctrl + K.**

**Explanation:**

__
 
• To insert a hyperlink for the selected text in Microsoft Word, the keyboard shortcut used is Ctrl + K.
 
• This shortcut opens the Insert Hyperlink dialog box, where the user can specify the hyperlink address (URL), select a file or web page, and add a description for the hyperlink.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ctrl + M is used to indent the selected paragraph.
 
• Ctrl + H is used to open the Replace dialog box in Microsoft Word.
 
• Ctrl + Z is used to undo the last action in Microsoft Word.
